evidence.ACL: Low grade, remote, partial thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Mild hyperintensity is seen at the posterior horn suggestive of intrasubstance degeneration. No definite tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment: Mild chondrosis of the medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment: Mild chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.PF OA: Findings are favored to represent severe chondropathic change involving the articular cartilage of the patella.
evidence.Effusion: No joint effusion or loose body.
evidence.Synovitis: Differential diagnoses such as focal synovitis and PVNS are less probable.
evidence.Contusion: Bones: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.
evidence.Fracture: Bones: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.
